scope: Fortnite season, pass and ranked lifecycle intelligence for France/Europe
source_of_truth: Official Fortnite/Epic product, news, competitive and status sources according to field authority.

principles.independent_tracks: Battle Royale season, Battle Pass, OG Pass, Festival season/pass, LEGO Pass, mini/collab passes and Ranked season are independent tracks that may overlap.
principles.pass_end_not_season_end: A pass end date never proves the gameplay season end or next-season launch time.
principles.season_end_not_next_start: A season end date never proves the next season starts immediately afterward.
principles.rank_reset_independent: A Ranked reset is its own lifecycle milestone and is not inferred from a season launch unless Epic explicitly links them.
principles.no_fake_precision: DATE_ONLY, DATE_RANGE and vague windows remain distinct from exact timestamps; never synthesize an hour.
principles.official_only: Leaks, datamining and inferred Battle Pass UI timers may be watch signals only unless an authorized official source confirms the field.
principles.stable_identity: track_id is immutable across enrichments, extensions, reschedules and corrections.
principles.append_only_history: Material transitions append history; current state never silently erases an earlier official value.
principles.calendar_is_projection: The lifecycle ledger is canonical; updates/global .ics receive only actionable milestones that pass the calendar threshold.

INCLUDE: exact or date-only official pass end with meaningful last-chance value
official ranked reset with actionable timing
major pass launch/end when officially dated
official transition downtime linked to a season launch
WATCH_ONLY: ranked cycle relationship that is only inferred
calendar_policy.anti_bazar: Prefer one logical lifecycle milestone per meaningful action. Do not create separate VEVENTs for announcement, teaser and every reward beat unless independently actionable.

deadline_bridge.legacy_compatibility: Existing BATTLE_PASS_END_DATE entries remain valid; new generic pass deadlines use PASS_END_AT with pass_type metadata.
deadline_bridge.exactness: Clock reminders require EXACT official timestamps. DATE_ONLY may create a day-level last-day notice but never a fabricated clock deadline.

service_bridge.rule: Downtime is stored canonically in FORTNITE_SERVICE_INTELLIGENCE_FR_V2 and linked here only when an authorized official source explicitly connects it to this lifecycle transition.
service_bridge.no_same_day_inference: Same-day maintenance and pass/season end do not prove a transition relationship.
